mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 1% for two consecutive months predicts higher S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced real interest rates encouraging equity investment.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 1% and remains above for ≥2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day moving average of the prior month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS accompanied by a decline in UNRATE over the next month is associated with stronger labor market momentum and higher S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by ≥2% while UNRATE decreases by ≥0.2% in the following month
regime_hint: expanding labor market with declining unemployment expectations
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over 60-day window across 5 backtests, or SPX 60-day returns are not outperforming risk-free rate by 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in HOUST above 600 indicates accelerating industrial demand, which precedes a positive S&P 20-day forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in at least 60% of HOUST > 600 events.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in INDPRO below 95.0 suggests supply-side softness, which is associated with negative S&P 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.1) during INDPRO < 95.0 periods.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL rising by ≥2% over the next quarter is a leading indicator of inflation expectations, which precedes negative S&P 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by ≥2% in the following 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during inflation spikes.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 7% combined with a rise in PAYEMS above 130,000 suggests labor market softening and a negative 20-day SPX forward return.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 7% and PAYEMS > 130,000 in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not negative in >70% of such trigger events (walk-forward).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in GDPC1 above 12,500 billion Chained Dollars indicate robust consumer demand, predicting positive S&P 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive in 80% of GDPC1 up moves (walk-forward).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained RSAFS decline of 10% over the next 3 months reflects supply chain stress, which is associated with a negative S&P 20-day forward return in contractionary regimes.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not negative during RSAFS declines (p > 0.1 in t-test).
